description: A one-bedroom on the south corner, over the street. You can see the traffic and hear none of it. Warm oak, a platform bed, a galley kitchen in grey stone, and glass from floor to ceiling on two sides. Leave north to the landing.

window.description: A tall pane runs floor to ceiling down one wall, black-framed, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the window

name: Solenne Residence 8-G
